text:
emily_ng: Posting the postmortem follow-ups from last night's outage — want to make sure we convert the remediation items into concrete tests.
jordaan: Thanks — can you paste the action list? I want to scope the regression additions for the next sprint.
emily_ng: Sure. Root causes: (1) slow KV eviction under burst load, (2) model fallback mismatch on quantized variant, (3) subtle prompt normalization bug in pipelined caching.
kevin_t: For (1) we should add a KV eviction chaos test + a load profile that reproduces the burst. I can own the KV chaos test.
maria_p: I'll take (2) — add a small deterministic eval that compares outputs between full and quantized variants on the canary prompt set.
emily_ng: Action items summary:
- KV chaos test (owner: kevin_t) — baseline load + 2x burst, expect eviction under threshold, target infra SLOs.
- Quantized-vs-full eval (owner: maria_p) — 200 prompt pairs, deterministic scoring, regression gate if delta > 1.5%.
- Prompt normalization unit tests + regression promptset (owner: jordaan) — add 50 edge prompts from the incident traces.
- Rollout checklist update (owner: emily_ng) — include automatic rollback if model mismatch detected.
jordaan: Quick Q: where do we store the new prompt set? repo: infra/evals/promptsets or eng-ml/evals?
maria_p: Put it in eng-ml/evals/promptsets/incident-2025-06-KV-evict
kevin_t: I sketched a quick chaos snippet to run in the chaos harness:
```
chaos run --attack kv-evict --target serving-pool --load-profile burst-2x --duration 5m
```
kevin_t: That will exercise eviction and we can capture latency + failed-cache metrics.
emily_ng: Timeline proposals:
- This week: start KV chaos smoke + collect traces (owner kevin_t) — due Fri
- Next week: run full regression with new promptset and quantized eval (owners maria_p + jordaan) — due Wed
- Two weeks: merge rollout checklist and add CI gates (owner emily_ng) — due in 2 wks
jordaan: Can we add an automated job to run the quantized-vs-full eval nightly for a week post-change? I want early warning.
maria_p: Yes — I'll add a GitHub Actions job to run the eval and post results to #eng-ml-evals. If delta spikes, it will create an Issue tagged eval/regression.
emily_ng: Also note recurring pattern: incidents with KV eviction happen ~monthly in burst windows. We should add the new load profile to our weekly soak test matrix.
kevin_t: Agreed. I'll add the burst-2x profile to the load test harness and mark it as 'smoke' for every PR touching KV path.
sre-bot: Reminder: create incident follow-up ticket linking postmortem -> test additions (template: postmortem->testplan). Use label: incident-followup.
emily_ng: I'll file the ticket now and link the owners. Will add checklist items:
- [ ] KV chaos smoke added (kevin_t)
- [ ] Promptset committed (jordaan)
- [ ] Quantized eval CI (maria_p)
- [ ] Rollout rollback automation (emily_ng)
jordaan: Thanks. I'll start curating the 50 edge prompts from logs and add them to the promptset by Thu.
maria_p: I'll draft the eval harness, include seed/temperature control and deterministic prompt ordering to avoid flaky deltas.
emily_ng: Perfect. Can each owner post a short status update in this thread when they hit their milestone? Keeps follow-ups visible.
kevin_t: Will do — KV chaos smoke in progress, posting preliminary traces when done.
maria_p: Draft PR for quantized eval up by Monday.
jordaan: Promptset PR by Thu. Marking owners in the follow-up ticket.
emily_ng: Awesome. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
